rule: If code is schema-valid but not target-equivalent, repair receiver coverage, service coverage, dataflow, numeric, and enum grounding.
Choose the smallest JOILang skeleton that matches the command verb, timing, target receiver, and side effect.
Preserve command-implied device, owner, location, and group selector tags in the receiver expression.
Read descriptor, return_descriptor, argument_type, and argument_bounds before choosing service names or numeric units.
Convert elapsed time and units exactly according to the service descriptor before writing numeric literals.
When reading a value for reporting or control, bind it to a variable and use that variable in the downstream action.
Emit only actions required by the command; remove unrelated reads, duplicate actions, and invented wrappers.
